timing.note: Source clips are treated as 30fps. After Corridor Key, sampleEvery=N means the sheet has every Nth frame; default playbackFps ≈ 30/N (e.g. every 4 → 7.5fps) so wall-clock timing matches the original clip. Clip SFX from autosprite_get_sounds should start with the animation when played at that fps — changing fps without retiming audio desyncs sound.
timing.soundSync: Start the extracted MP3 with this animation when playing at spriteSheet.fps (default = sourceFps/sampleEvery).
